business_problem: With an aim to help businesses improve document efficiency and transparency, Document360 wanted to build an AI-powered knowledge base and service platform.
solution_summary: With an aim to help businesses improve document efficiency and transparency, Document360 wanted to build an AI-powered knowledge base and service platform. Document360 was built on Microsoft Azure so that companies can create, manage, and publish online documentation, including product manuals, SOPs, and wikis. It’s an AI-powered knowledge base and service platform built on Microsoft Azure to help businesses create, manage, and publish online documentation, including product manuals, SOPs, wikis, and more. “Every company needs robust knowledge management, and Document360 is customizable to meet their unique needs.” Knowing Document360 could gain widespread use, the developers chose to build the platform on Azure for its scalability, performance, enhanced security, and compliance. Document360 supports upward of 100,000 active users a month. The product’s AI-enhanced capabilities have resulted in a 50% increase in customer engagement and reduced operational costs for Document360 by 40%.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs the generative AI experience that answers questions, summarizes content, or drafts outputs for users.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves relevant passages to ground search and assistant responses.

solution_components.name: Azure App Service
solution_components.role: Hosts the application web layer and API services for the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure SQL
solution_components.role: Stores structured operational and analytical data used by the application.

solution_components.name: Azure Logic Apps
solution_components.role: Connects systems and automates process steps between application components.

solution_components.name: Azure Service Bus
solution_components.role: Coordinates asynchronous messaging between application services.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the secure, scalable cloud foundation for the solution.
